interface.description: Network interface to transmit packets on.

pcap_files.description: List of paths to pcap capture files.

packet_length.description: Packet length mode: 0 = actual on-wire length, -1 = captured length, or integer [14..9014] for fixed length. Requires jumbogram=true for >1514 bytes.

loop.description: Number of times to loop over pcap files. 0 = loop indefinitely until stopped (Ctrl+C).

count.description: Maximum number of packets to send. 0 = send all packets from pcap file(s).

pps.description: Packets per second (range: 1..1000000). Overrides rate_mbps and gap_seconds.

rate_mbps.description: Rate limit in Mbps (range: 0..10000). Overrides gap_seconds. 0 = no limit. Recommended for high-throughput: start low (e.g., 10 Mbps) if encountering 'No buffer space available'.

gap_seconds.description: Inter-packet gap in seconds (range: 1..86400). Overrides captured timestamps. 0 = use original timestamps.

jumbogram.description: Enable jumbo frames (MTU up to 9000 bytes). Required for packet_length > 1514.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level: 0 = quiet, 1 = print timestamps, 2 = timestamps + hex dump.
